profile.headline: UI / UX Designer and Front-End Web Developer | Figma | Wordpress | Shopify | WebFlow | Wix | HTML | CSS | JavaScript
profile.summary:
UI/UX Designer and Front-End Web Developer with experience designing and building user-centered digital experiences from UX strategy through front-end development. Skilled in information architecture, wireframing, high-fidelity UI, and design systems, with hands-on development in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid across WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow. Experienced managing multiple concurrent client projects while maintaining a 100% on-time delivery record. Proficient in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and cross-functional collaboration from design through deployment.

SKILLS

UX Strategy | Information Architecture | Content Strategy | User Flows | Wireframing | Accessibility | CRO | High-Fidelity UI | Design Systems | Component Libraries | Figma | Auto Layout & Variables | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Liquid | Email Development | WordPress | Shopify | Webflow | Elementor | Divi | PageFly | HubSpot | Mailchimp | Photoshop | Illustrator | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Design-to-Development Handoff | Quality Assurance

positions.title: UX Designer and Web Developer
positions.description:
• Communicate with clients in zoom meeting to understand their user needs and pain points 
• Create landing pages based on the client meeting creating a design that meets their needs
positions.insights: Skills: Landing Pages · User Experience Design (UED) · Prototyping · Figma · Communication · Wireframing

positions.title: Senior Creative Web Designer and Developer
positions.description: I work directly with Creative Directors on short and long term projects to create web designs and development as well as email designs and development. I use my skill as a Web and UX designer to create products that meet all the clients needs. I work fast and efficiently making sure each product is completed on time and the highest quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Landing Pages · Figma · Webflow · Email Design · HubSpot · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Server
positions.description: Skills: Skilled Multi-tasker · Organization Skills · Communication · Time Management

positions.title: Project Manager Apprentice
positions.description: As a project manger apprentice I communicated with all the teams to make sure there was clear communication between all the teams to ensure the project stayed on schedule and in the scope. I lead daily meetings with the team. I also assisted the project manager lead with communication between the teams and making sure the notion was up to date.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · notion · Communication · Team Management · Organization Skills · virtual meetings · Cross-functional Team Leadership

positions.title: Bartender
positions.description:
• Training new bartenders instilling communication and teamwork decreasing turnover by 5%
Maintaining standards by leading by example creating a positive work environment that increased regulars by 10%
• Revitalized cleaning list by organizing it to be more efficient and easier to maintain weekly resulting in better working conditions
• Streamlined preparation procedures for recipes by organization and spreadsheet reducing preparation time by 30 minutes
positions.insights: Skills: Positive Work Environment · excellent customer service · Staff Training

positions.title: Kitchen Manager
positions.description:
• Tested new recipes before being launched in all stores and ran food demos for 8 kitchen managers to create a smooth launch
• Led and wrote agenda for bi-weekly kitchen manager conference call with 8 kitchen managers in the region
• Trained staff, put systems in place, and organized the kitchen creating an increase in sales by 15% and decreased comps by 20%
positions.insights: Skills: Operations Management · Team Building · Decision-Making · Increase Productivity · Staff Training · Interpersonal Communication

positions.title: Kitchen Manager
positions.description:
• Scored Highest in the company - General Manager Assessment
• Promotion to Kitchen Manager -  within the first year of being promoted to a manager
• 1st place in the region - Culinary Champs Competition 
• Maintained weekly and monthly budget spreadsheets and organized all invoices, P&L every week, and paid expenses
• Strong management skills overseeing a team of 90- 100 employees managed schedules, labor costs, training, and ensuring quality service to every customer in a 5 million a year store
positions.insights: Skills: Inventory Management · task prioritization · Creative Problem Solving · Staff Training · Project Management
